criteria_results.text: Agents Terminal tab opens a working shell in the notarized release build (PTY create succeeds).
criteria_results.notes: v18.52 fixed the PTY dlopen rejection but REGRESSED the engine launch. New in-app error: 'Could not resume session: Opencode engine not ready (Server exited with code null)'. The opencode bun binary SIGTRAP-crashed in dyld at launch (exit 133). No contract/local check asserted that the signed binary still LAUNCHES — only that the entitlement was present and the plist valid. The launch crash only manifests in a signed hardened-runtime build, so it was invisible to the v18.52 checks.

process_issues.description: A codesign/entitlements change to the bundled opencode binary was shipped to a notarized release (v18.52) without any local hardened-runtime launch test. Root cause: adding com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation ALONE turned on Hardened Runtime JIT enforcement for the bun binary, which then needed com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit + allow-unsigned-executable-memory or it is killed at launch. Signing with no entitlements (v18.51) was lenient and launched; the partial entitlement set crashed.
process_issues.detected_by: User manual smoke of installed v18.52; reproduced locally by launching /Applications/Rhythm.app/.../opencode_bin/opencode (exit 133) and by reading the crash report (.ips: Trace/BPT trap SIGTRAP in /usr/lib/dyld).

issues.description: verification-gate emitted PASS and the run proceeded to merge + release on a verification that asserted entitlement PRESENCE and plist validity, not the signed binary's LAUNCH behavior. The gate did honestly document the end-to-end gap as release-build-only (so this is a soft W5, not a no-evidence claim), but the behavior gap turned out to be locally testable after all: re-signing the binary under hardened runtime (codesign --options runtime --entitlements ... -s -) reproduces both the crash and the fix. The class of change (codesign entitlements on a bun standalone) had a cheap local behavioral test that was not run.
issues.detected_by: Transcript review of the #752 verification-gate PASS block vs. the post-release crash; confirmed the local re-sign test exists and is decisive (used to verify #756).

failure_output: Could not resume session: AppError: Opencode engine not ready (Opencode SDK error: Server exited with code null). Direct launch: opencode serve -> exit 133 (SIGTRAP). Crash report: termination SIGNAL code 5 'Trace/BPT trap: 5' in /usr/lib/dyld; codeSigningID opencode, codeSigningTeamID 56Q69NYP9H.
suggested_follow_up: For any codesign/entitlements change to a bundled bun (or other JIT/standalone) binary, verification-gate MUST run a local hardened-runtime launch+behavior test (cp binary; codesign --force --options runtime --entitlements <file> -s -; run it; exercise the affected feature) instead of treating launch as release-build-only. Entitlement PRESENCE is not entitlement CORRECTNESS.
